Boundary Likelihood Ratio Test for Transition Heterogeneity

Source: R/manMetaVAR-lrt-meta-var.R
LRTMetaVAR.Rd

Tests whether the between-person covariance matrix of the transition parameters is zero in a fitted MetaVAR Stage 2 model. The model is refitted with the transition rows and columns of \(\boldsymbol{\tau}^2\) fixed at zero (variances at the lower bound of the softplus parameterization), and the likelihood ratio statistic is referred to a simulated chi-bar-square distribution for the cone of positive semidefinite matrices, using the Fisher information at the null fit, and to the naive chi-square distribution.

Usage

LRTMetaVAR(
  fit,
  block = 3:6,
  others = 1:2,
  cross = FALSE,
  draws = 2000L,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

fit

Fitted MetaVAR Stage 2 model: an object returned by FitMetaVAR(), by metaDyn::MetaVARMx(), or the underlying MxModel.

block

Integer vector. Positions of the transition parameters in \(\boldsymbol{\tau}^2\).

others

Integer vector. Positions of the remaining random effects in \(\boldsymbol{\tau}^2\).

cross

Logical. If cross = TRUE, the covariances between block and others are free in fit and are also set to zero under the null hypothesis.

draws

Positive integer. Number of draws from the chi-bar-square distribution.

seed

Integer. Random seed for the chi-bar-square draws.

Value

A one-row data frame with the -2 log-likelihoods of the full and null models, the statistic, the null-fit status code, the number of tested parameters (df), the chi-bar-square p-value and 95% critical value, and the naive chi-square p-value.

See also

Other Model Fitting Functions: FitDTVAR(), FitMetaVAR(), FitMplus(), FitMplusDiagnostics(), FitNaive(), MplusInput()

Author

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
seed <- 42
data <- GenData(taskid = 25, seed = seed)
fit <- FitDTVAR(data = data, seed = seed)
meta <- FitMetaVAR(fit = fit, seed = seed)
LRTMetaVAR(fit = meta, seed = seed)
} # }
